{{Quote|There is an organization of mercenaries here on Talus that is giving me fits. They are called the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium|Quellium]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
The '''Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony''', or '''N.S.H.''' for short, was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I see here that the Empire's affiliates resort to torture unnecessarily. I also notice that almost everyone you spoke with in the Nightstrike Hegemony were human males.|[[Dathnaeya Loessin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CoA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Crisis of Allegiance|Talus}}</ref>}}
[[File:NSHOfficer.jpg|thumb|left|175px|An officer of the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]]
The Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony was a unit of mercenaries that operated on the planet Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Its [[N.S.H. base|headquarters]] were located in the [[Ageyn Foothills]]. During the Galactic Civil War between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the N.S.H. was affiliated with the Galactic Empire and directly involved in the fight against the Rebellion. Indeed, the N.S.H. had very similar points of view with the Empire. The N.S.H. mercenaries were all [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> Furthermore, they usually practiced [[Torture/Legends|torture]] during their interrogations. In addition to their mercenaries, the N.S.H. also used [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] such as [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]].<ref name="SWG:MO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Medical Officer|Talus}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony is looking to join the Empire as a full military branch rather than remain a separate entity.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk|Ekirk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
[[File:NSHBase.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[N.S.H. base]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galiir Ac Yandar]], the N.S.H. commander, sought to make his unit a full military branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial armed forces]] rather than a separate entity.<ref name="SWG:II" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ac Yandar met Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk]] in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] to negotiate the new operational status of the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony. Although Ekirk deeply despised Galiir, he considered that the N.S.H. could be a valuable asset for the Empire. However, the negotiations were disturbed when [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]], an anti-Imperial movement, planted information that almost ruined Yandar's reputation with the Empire. Colonel Ekirk thus dispatched a spacer who was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] to raid the [[A.C.L.O. office]]. Galiir Ac Yandar ordered the spacer to kill [[Leeta Poandeu]], the slicer who was responsible for slicing his system, and then contact and assist [[Mark Hieks]], a N.S.H. [[Spy/Legends|covert operative]] infiltrated in the A.C.L.O. office. Ekirk also tasked the spacer to slain A.C.L.O. terrorists who sabotaged Imperial shipments. The spacer eventually achieved all those objectives and was rewarded for the assistance.<ref name="SWG:II" />

Around the same time, N.S.H. troops shut down an A.C.L.O. clinic and imprisoned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer [[Syirlabradawk]]. They also confiscated a shipment of medical supplies before its delivery to Rebel forces on Talus. Alliance [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium|Quellium]] and the A.C.L.O. representative [[Trezya Nenei]] therefore sent a spacer to the N.S.H. base. The spacer assaulted the base and managed to retrieve the medical shipment and rescue the medical officer, killing many N.S.H. enforcers in the process. The death of so much N.S.H. mercenaries later allowed the A.C.L.O. to easily ambush an unit of N.S.H. enforcers and stole their shipment of Imperial medical computers.<ref name="SWG:RI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The N.S.H. was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
